TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit SKGraphiteContext extends SkiaSharp.SKObject

Docs.summary: Represents a Graphite GPU context, the entry point for recording and executing GPU work with the Graphite rendering backend.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
A Graphite context wraps a native graphics API device (Vulkan, Metal, or Dawn/WebGPU) and is created with one of the `Create*` factory methods. Use <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.CreateRecorder%2A> to obtain a recorder, record GPU work, snap it into a recording, then insert the recording with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.InsertRecording%2A> and submit it with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.Submit%2A>.
